points.what: North America orders fell 13.1% WoW, contributing -23 orders, the largest share of the week's order decline at 74.2%.
points.so_what: This was the single largest driver of the week's order shortfall against target.

points.what: Organic orders fell 20.5% WoW, contributing -27 orders, 87.1% of the week's total decline.
points.so_what: This was the largest driver of the order decline among traffic sources this week.

points.what: APAC orders rose 4.6% WoW, contributing +14 orders, partially offsetting the week's decline.
points.so_what: This limited the size of the week's overall order drop but wasn't enough to keep the week at target.

points.what: AOV was $82.07, down 4.2% WoW and down 1.3% YoY, flagged as notable for falling outside its 8-week range.
points.so_what: The revenue miss this week reflects lower spend per order, not just fewer orders.

points.what: The cancellation rate fell to 13.6%, down 2.9 pp WoW and down 0.9 pp YoY, both rated good and marked notable.
points.so_what: Fewer cancelled orders support revenue realization even though the week finished behind target.

points.what: The 14-Day Return Rate for the week of 19 Jan 2026 was 11.2%, up 1.4 pp WoW and up 1.4 pp YoY, both rated bad and marked notable.
points.so_what: This works against order quality in the opposite direction from this week's cancellation-rate improvement.

points.what: New signups fell to 230, down 15.8% WoW and down 8.4% YoY, both rated bad and marked notable.
points.so_what: This is a second bad-direction metric this week alongside the order and revenue shortfall.

summary.headline: Orders and revenue both missed target this week, and at the current pace the full-year revenue target is out of reach.

points.what: Weekly orders were 92.5% of target and revenue was 85.3% of target, both rated behind.
points.so_what: Both fell short of the week's target, with revenue trailing further behind than orders.

points.what: AOV fell 4.2% WoW to $82.07, notable for sitting outside its 8-week range, while orders fell 4.0% WoW.
points.so_what: The revenue decline reflects both fewer orders and lower spend per order.

points.what: YTD revenue attainment is 92.8% of target-to-date, with the current 8-week run-rate of $53,556 well below the $75,745 needed weekly to reach the full-year target.
points.so_what: At this pace, the full-year revenue target is out of reach.

points.what: New signups fell 15.8% WoW and 8.4% YoY, both rated bad and marked notable.
points.so_what: This adds a second area of weakness alongside the order and revenue miss this week.

points.what: Weekly orders were 92.5% of target and revenue was 85.3% of target, both rated behind.
points.so_what: Both KPIs missed the week's target, with revenue lagging further behind orders.

points.what: QTD and YTD revenue attainment are both 92.8% of target-to-date, a gap of $25,552, with 7 weeks left in the quarter.
points.so_what: The quarter and year are both running behind target with ground still to make up.

points.what: The required weekly revenue run-rate to reach the full-year target is $75,745, compared with a current 8-week run-rate of $53,556.
points.so_what: At this pace, the full-year revenue target is out of reach.

points.what: The quarter is behind target, with $445,746 still needed against the full-quarter target over the remaining 7 weeks.
points.so_what: Closing this gap requires revenue well above the recent weekly pace before the quarter ends.

points.what: The 14-Day Return Rate for the week of 19 Jan 2026 rose to 11.2%, up 1.4 pp WoW and up 1.4 pp YoY, both rated bad.
points.so_what: This offsets the improvement seen in this week's cancellation rate.

points.what: Next week's order target rises to 845, above this week's total.
points.so_what: Reaching it requires a larger rebound than this week's shortfall against target.
